politics.summary:
The Delhi High Court has dismissed pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. Meanwhile, the Supreme Court is set to list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar, where protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

In other news, Jairam Ramesh has attacked the CEC, claiming that his ability to execute illegal orders makes him a liability for the country. Congress has also condemned the detention of tribal students who were headed to Mumbai to protest.

Elsewhere, Donald Trump has called the US electoral process 'corrupt', citing an Indian election that didn't happen. This appears to be a mix-up with Brazil, which held the first round of its presidential election on Sunday.

Finally, Bengali actor Koel Mallick has joined the BJP, and India's foreign exchange reserves have reportedly declined by USD 18.34 billion in a single week.
